newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to investigate ex-GE unit losses.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to investigate ex-GE unit losses.

text.p: Hungarian Finance Minister Peter Medgyessy has initiated an investigation into losses posted by Polgari Bank, recently repurchased by the state from General Electric-controlled Budapest Bank (BB).

"The investigation aims at clarifying what causes contributed to losses at the financial institution, and will examine (the bank's) relations with individuals and business partners," the ministry said in a statement on Thursday.
The ministry did not disclose financial details of Polgari's 1996 results.

The state repurchased Polgari from BB in December, fulfilling a state guarantee to General Electric Capital Services and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, investors which bought a joint majority stake in BB in December 1995.
The state undertook in the privatisation contract to buy part of BB's assets back from the investors.
Opposition politicians have sharply criticised the government for the BB deal, saying that the privatisation conditions were unfavourable for the state.
The investigation into the Polgari case should be finished by February 27, the ministry said.
